page.overview:
Who is Bus Brothers?

The are three brothers working for Metro City's bus company that appear in Street Fighter 6's World Tour mode.

The Bus Brothers are three bulky men with short hair. At first glance they appear to be tough, but they actually are cowardly and have little to no fighting experience. They wear a yellow and black uniform from Metro City's bus company. The first letter from their names form the word bus:

The Bus Brothers are working to expand the number of bus stops in Metro City, something that was pitched in order to ease the problem caused by the large number of thugs in the subway. Afraid of where they would work next, they played Rock, Paper, Scissors to decide where each would work. Each ran with a problem during their work, and the Avatar can help them with it. Completing their sub-missions will make a new bus stop appear, which unlocks a fast travel point for it when interacted.

Bobby asks for help with a member of the Canary Crate Gang being on the way of building a new bus stop, giving the sub-mission Canary Crate Tyranny.
